phases.title: Plan
tasks: Define the goal, the audience, and the expected number of participants
Choose a date, a location, and a backup plan

phases.title: Get approval
tasks: Ask your school or organization for permission to host
Collect written consent for any participant under 18
Confirm adult supervision for every session

phases.title: Prepare
tasks: Gather materials and build a simple budget
Write a safety plan that fits the activity
Create a sign-up or RSVP page

phases.title: Run and document
tasks: Run the event and record attendance and hours
Add outcomes and photos (with permission) to your Portfolio

Environment: Water sampling: wear gloves, use the containers your sponsor provides, and never drink or taste samples.
Outdoor sites: get landowner or park permission before entering, and bring a first-aid kit.
STEM: Lab-style activities: review chemical and equipment rules with your sponsor before the event.

sponsorMessage: Hello {sponsor}, I am a student planning "{name}" on {date} for about {participants} participants. The goal is: {description} Would you be willing to serve as the adult sponsor and confirm that you will supervise the activity? Thank you, {student}.
outcomeSuggestions: Number of participants who completed the activity
A change you made, such as a cleanup, a report, or a follow-up event

demoExample.name: Water Quality Awareness Workshop
demoExample.description: Teach classmates how water quality is tested and why it matters for our neighborhood, using safe demonstration kits.
